title: PC-S-01: Stripe secret key in app/checkout/page.tsx
user_impact: Attackers can act as the product against customer data. Anyone with repository access (or a public mirror) holds working credentials.

root_cause.hypothesis: Credentials were pasted into code or committed configuration instead of the runtime secret store.

constraints: Do not commit secrets, credentials or real customer data; use environment variables and synthetic data.
Keep the change minimal and focused on the listed findings; do not refactor unrelated code.
Do not disable, skip or delete tests or checks to make them pass.
Do not mark this packet done without a Product Check retest showing the control PASS with new evidence.
Security- or data-sensitive change: a human must review and approve before merge.
Change only what the packet's scope guard allows; anything else needs a new review.
Do not disable, skip or weaken tests, checks or security controls to make verification pass.
Use synthetic data; never commit credentials or real personal data.
A proposed fix is not a verified fix: run product-check verify against the exact fix commit.
An agent cannot approve its own change; closure needs signed human approval for the risk tier.
proposed_change: Rotate (revoke and reissue) every exposed credential first, then move it to environment variables / the hosting secret store and remove it from the code. Treat the history as compromised.

tests_required.description: Product Check re-assesses PC-S-01 at the fix commit (built into verify). Also declare a test that fails before the fix and passes after it (fix --repro-cmd).
A secret-scanning pre-commit hook or CI step (for example gitleaks) on every pull request.

negative_cases: An unauthenticated request to the affected path is refused (401/403), not served.
A signed-in user cannot read or change another user's or tenant's record by changing an ID.
No credential or privileged value appears in the client bundle or responses.
acceptance_conditions: Each listed credential has been rotated at its provider (human confirmation).
No secret pattern matches in repository files.
Control PC-S-01 evaluates PASS on retest.
Finding PCF-50D5C47465 (app/checkout/page.tsx:1) is no longer observed on retest.
product-check verify --finding F-001 passes at the exact fix commit (targeted + regression).
